mission_07: Excellent analysis! You have compared three major scaling methods and observed their different behaviors with outliers. You learned that MinMaxScaler compresses most data when outliers exist, StandardScaler centers but still shows outlier influence, and RobustScaler preserves the relative positions of the majority of data points. There is no single best scaler, the choice depends on your data and algorithm. Use MinMax for neural networks and image data, Standard for linear models and PCA, and Robust when outliers are present and meaningful. This comparative understanding is crucial for effective preprocessing.
